statements.status_notes: PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-14681, improper enforcement of GSSAPI encryption when a connection starts with direct TLS, so a connection can proceed over TLS alone despite pg_hba.conf rules that require GSSAPI, in 17.11. Within major version 17, releases before 17.11 are affected. Versions before PostgreSQL 17 are not affected. https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-14681/, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/17.11/. Debian fixed it for trixie in postgresql-17 17.11-0+deb13u1 (DSA-6438-1): https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-14681. The fixed version is this owner's first rebuild of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1, which packages PostgreSQL 17.11 and is no longer in the repository. Every build published now carries the fix: the postgres server binary reports PostgreSQL 17.11 in the current rebuild of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1 and in the 17.11-1 build, and PostgreSQL 17.12 in the 17.12-0 build and in the rebuild of Debian's 17.12-0+deb13u1, on amd64 and arm64. The earlier rebuild of Debian's 17.10-0+deb13u1, no longer in the repository, packages PostgreSQL 17.10; it is affected and sorts below the fixed version.
